title: 第161章 忍耐
slug: 求生游戏请叫我诚信商人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

她穿着商人斗篷，面容并不清晰。

若不是李知对她这双桀骜又认真的眼睛实在记忆深刻，很难将她认出来。

只是……

她的鱼尾，为什么断了？

李知放下手中的砂砾，装作若无其事地对原料商道：“这沙子品质一般，我去另一家看看。”

原料商对这样的情况习以为常。

轻哼一声表示不满和知道。

李知取出之前区域财富榜送的空间背包，快速将里面的物资全部清空，走到另一个原料商面前，蹲下查看沙子。

手中的备用偷天换日再次被复制了一张放在空间吊坠里。

未用完的传音卡出现在手中。

被镶嵌在铁矿上的空间背包与涂前方一枚小小的废弃矿石悄悄调换了位置。

“低头，捡起你脚边上那枚矿石，不要有任何停留，按照你的原计划走。”

涂一愣，斗篷下，断裂的鱼尾却没有停止移动。

她像是寻常的低级商人，看到了地上有一颗遗落的铁矿，就自然而然捡起，又有些心虚地快速离开。

周围的原料商有人注意到这一幕，也并不在意。

很多低级商人比拾荒者还穷，身上根本没有什么可以交易的东西，到各大交易区捡漏和“捡垃圾”也是她们的工作之一。

“第一个格子里是一张面具，第二个各自是分身道具，第三个格子是隐身道具，第四个格子是D级药剂，第五个格子是绷带，第六个格子里有一些食物，加起来价值超过了30金，你要是死了就人死摘下，要是活着，记得来找我还债。”

李知与原料商交易沙子时，视线范围内的十多座电梯，同时停在原料层。

无数鳞族护卫和熔锻族护卫从里面快速冲了出来。

她们身穿盔甲和机甲，拿着李知不认识的高科技扫描仪，迅速在每一个商人、顾客身上扫描着。

蓝光笼罩在她身上时。

李知心中一紧，但蓝光没有任何异样。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

She was wearing a merchant's cloak, and her face was unclear.

If Li Zhi hadn't remembered her unruly and serious eyes so deeply, it would have been difficult to recognize her.

Just...

Why is her fish tail broken?

Li Zhi put down the gravel in his hand and pretended to be nonchalant and said to the raw material dealer: "The quality of this sand is average. I'll go to another shop to have a look."

Raw material vendors are used to this situation.

A slight snort expresses dissatisfaction and knowledge.

Li Zhi took out the space backpack given by the regional wealth list, quickly emptied all the materials inside, walked to another raw material dealer, squatted down and looked at the sand.

The spare copy of the "Shuitianzhuanri" in his hand was once again copied and placed in the space pendant.

The unused sound transmission card appears in the hand.

The space backpack embedded in the iron ore quietly switched places with a small abandoned ore in front of Tu.

"Lower your head, pick up the ore at your feet, don't stop at any time, and follow your original plan."

Tu was stunned. Under the cloak, the broken fish tail did not stop moving.

She was like an ordinary low-level businessman. When she saw a piece of iron ore left on the ground, she picked it up naturally and left quickly with a guilty conscience.

Some of the surrounding raw material merchants noticed this scene but didn't care.

Many low-level merchants are poorer than scavengers and have nothing to trade with them. It is also one of their jobs to go to major trading areas to pick up leaks and "trash".

"The first grid is a mask, the second grid is a clone prop, the third grid is an invisibility prop, the fourth grid is a D-level potion, the fifth grid is a bandage, and the sixth grid contains some food, the total value of which exceeds 30 gold. If you die, you will be killed. If you are alive, remember to come to me to pay off your debt."

When Li Zhi was trading sand with the raw material dealer, more than a dozen elevators within sight stopped at the raw material floor at the same time.

Countless Scale Clan guards and Forging Clan guards quickly rushed out from inside.

Wearing armors and mechas, they held high-tech scanners that Li Zhi didn't recognize and quickly scanned every merchant and customer.

As blue light enveloped her.

Li Zhi's heart tightened, but there was nothing strange about the blue light.
